{{Quote|What I remember about the rise of the Empire is&hellip; is how quiet it was.|Retired clone trooper|<ref name="BFII" />}}
The '''retired clone trooper''' was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who claimed to serve with the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] from the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. As one of millions of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] bred from the [[DNA/Legends|genetic]] [[Clone template/Legends|template]] of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], the [[trooper]] was created to serve the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. By the end of the Clone Wars, however, the clone [[Army/Legends|army]] [[Order 66/Legends|betrayed]] their [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi generals]] and supported [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious']] [[Declaration of a New Order|rise to power]] as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. As a result, the Grand Army was reorganized into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], making the trooper and [[Gender/Legends|his]] brethren the [[Clone stormtrooper|first generation]] of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].

According to him, the trooper continued to serve in the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]]&mdash;led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]&mdash;over the course of the Emperor's reign. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of his retirement, the trooper recorded his recollections of various missions in a [[501st Journal|journal]] dedicated to the history of the 501st. His entries included confidential information pertaining to the [[Rise of the Empire era|final years]] of the Republic and the subsequent [[Imperial Era/Legends|era]] of the Empire.

==Biography==
===Fall of the Republic===
{{Quote|During the waning hours of the Clone Wars, the 501st Legion was discreetly transferred back to Coruscant. It was a silent trip. We all knew what was about to happen, what we were about to do. Did we have any doubts? Any private traitorous thoughts? Perhaps, but no one said a word. Not on the flight back to Coruscant, not when Order 66 came down, and not when we marched into the Jedi Temple. Not a word.|Retired clone trooper about [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] |<ref name="BFII" />}}
[[File:501stlegion1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The trooper served in the ranks of the 501st Legion during the Clone Wars.]]
By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] a [[4 ABY/Legends|year later]], a retired [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]&mdash;a first generation [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]&mdash;had authored a [[501st Journal|private journal]] which claimed to detail his life experiences as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial]] [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. The [[Trooper/Legends|trooper]], along with many other clones of the same [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]], was engineered in the [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] [[Tipoca City/Legends|cloning facilities]] for the sole purpose of becoming a soldier of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He was one of the first combat-ready [[unit]]s who composed the newly-formed [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]. Soon after surviving the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the trooper joined the ranks of the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]],<ref name="BFII" /> an [[elite]] [[Division/Legends|division]] of clone soldiers commissioned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="501st">{{DB|organization|five01st|501st Legion}}</ref>

The following three years resulted in an escalating [[civil war]] between the Galactic Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] rebellion. The trooper and a contingent of the 501st was often rotated from one battlefield to another during the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|campaign]]. His service record included missions on [[Battle of Mygeeto|Mygeeto]], [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. He also served as a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. Throughout these final battles of the Clone Wars, the trooper served under the command of several [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi General/Legends|officers]], such as [[High Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Just prior to the end of the Clone Wars, however, Chancellor Palpatine issued [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], the [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency directive]] that instructed all clone troopers to [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|kill]] their Jedi officers in the event of a "Jedi rebellion."<ref name="BFII" />

The clone trooper and the rest of the 501st were tasked with executing a mission, codenamed [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], to terminate everyone inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the trooper and his comrades [[Death/Legends|killed]] numerous [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi students]] and [[Temple Security Force|Temple guards]], including three [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who ultimately fell defending the Temple. Afterward, Palpatine was [[Declaration of a New Order|proclaimed]] [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the first [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; the remaining [[Clan Fett|Fett]] clones were rechristened as the [[Clone stormtrooper|first stormtroopers]] of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="BFII" />

===Rise of the Empire===
{{Quote|With the fall of Coruscant and the elimination of the traitorous Jedi, Palpatine's rise to power was complete. In recognition of our service and loyalty to the Emperor, the 501st were placed under the direct command of Lord Vader.|Retired clone trooper|<ref name="BFII" />}}
[[File:DarthVader-SWG4.png|thumb|right|250px|The trooper proudly upheld the 501st's reputation as "Vader's Fist."]]
Under the Empire, the former clone trooper participated in many covert operations that were personally handled by the 501st, which by then became known as "Vader's Fist" due to their ruthless efficiency and unique status as Darth Vader's personal legion. Over the next decade, they [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|defeated]] [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|insurrectionists]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|destroyed]] one of the last [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], and was even forced to [[Kamino uprising|exterminate]] an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Anti-trooper|rogue clone troopers]] that had been bred by a [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Kaminoan resistance|resistance faction]].<ref name="BFII" />

The trooper's final years as a soldier were marked by the outbreak of a new rebellion, formed by a growing [[organization]] known as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Death Star prisoner|Jedi prisoner]] led a group of Rebel and [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] captives in an [[Death Star Uprising|uprising]] on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]], codenamed "[[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]]." The trooper and a contingent of the 501st responded by putting down the prison riot, but ultimately failed to prevent the Rebels from beaming the [[Battle station/Legends|battle station's]] [[Death Star plans/Legends|schematic readouts]] to the Alliance's [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] base.<ref name="BFII" /> As a result of their failure, the 501st was reassigned to track and retrieve the stolen plans before the Rebels could discern any vital weaknesses in the Death Star's design. After surviving a [[Raid on Polis Massa|difficult skirmish]] against [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Alliance soldiers]] on Polis Massa, the trooper participated in an [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|assault]] on the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], capturing [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] in the process.<ref name="BFII" />

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] resulted in the destruction of the Death Star, the trooper and other surviving members of the 501st regrouped with other Imperial units in a [[Strike on Yavin 4|major counterattack]] against the Rebel Alliance. They successfully drove the remaining Rebel forces away from [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], although the trooper considered it to be a hollow victory due to the loss of the Death Star, countless Imperial lives, and two thirds of the 501st's total strength.<ref name="BFII" />

The trooper's last recorded entry in his journal detailed his thoughts on the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] and its aftermath. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Darth Vader and the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] discovered the Alliance's [[Echo Base/Legends|hidden base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The trooper was dispatched to the planet's surface with a large assault force consisting of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] and several [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]]. After destroying the planet's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], the 501st&mdash;led by Darth Vader in person&mdash;stormed the Alliance base and engaged the remaining Rebels in a firefight outside of the main hangar. They managed to plant a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] beneath one of the last [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]], thus enabling an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] to destroy the transport from orbit. The trooper and other soldiers of the 501st gathered around the burning remains of the fallen Rebel [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and celebrated what they believed was a symbol of the Rebellion's final destruction.<ref name="BFII" />

[[File:Darth_Vader.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The trooper regarded the Battle of Hoth as the 501st's "finest hour."]]
By the time of his discharge after many years of active service, the retired trooper was a veteran of the Clone Wars and the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He reminisced about the Rebel Alliance's defeat at the Battle of Hoth, an event which he also believed to be responsible for the restoration of order throughout the galaxy. Knowing that a [[Death Star II/Legends|new and larger Death Star]] was under construction, the former trooper felt secured in the belief that the Galactic Empire had prevailed once more, an achievement which he credited to the clone soldiers of Darth Vader's 501st Legion.<ref name="BFII" /> His confidence in the Empire's ultimate victory, however, was proven false. [[4 ABY/Legends|A year after]] the Battle of Hoth, the Alliance won a decisive victory at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], hence resulting in the [[Imperial Civil War|fragmentation]] of the Empire and the dissolution of the 501st Legion.<ref name="501st" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Though the 501st itself remained pure, the rest of the Imperial Army gradually became more and more diverse. We never really got used to the new guys.|Retired clone trooper|<ref name="BFII" />}}
The clone trooper was a fiercely loyal soldier who believed in what he and his brethren were created to be: an army of soldiers designed to be highly efficient and highly obedient. As a young clone, he was initially unsure of his readiness for war, admitting how years of training on Kamino did not compare to a real battlefield. However, the Republic's first victory on Geonosis reinforced the trooper's morale, believing himself battle-hardened and ready to serve the Republic in the Clone Wars.<ref name="BFII" />

In several entries of his journal, the trooper conveyed feelings of respect and even admiration for some members of the Jedi Order, particularly [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], whom he credited for single-handedly saving the 501st during its mission on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]]. The clone also held Yoda's fighting prowess in high regard, given that the trooper acknowledged how the Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master's]] presence on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] all but guaranteed the Republic's success against a Separatist invasion force.<ref name="BFII" />

Despite his unyielding loyalty to the Republic, the trooper privately questioned some of his orders on occasion, particularly the ones that he did not understand or even agree with. Although he later developed a new-found sense of appreciation for the combat skills of the Wookiee warriors, the trooper was initially dismayed at the thought of so many clones dying for a [[Species/Legends|race]] he dismissed as a "bunch of walking carpets." After Order 66 was initiated, the trooper quietly lamented the death of Secura, hoping that she was at least granted a quick death. During Operation: Knightfall, he concealed his own misgivings about the order to execute every member of the Jedi Order. Nevertheless, he remained focused on his duty, which he carried out with the same silence and cold determination that had overtaken the 501st Legion as they invaded the Jedi Temple.<ref name="BFII" />

Afterward, the clone adapted well to his new life as an Imperial stormtrooper. He staunchly supported the ideals of the New Order and obediently enforced Emperor Palpatine's rule through the brutal tactics that earned the 501st its nickname as "Vader's fist." When remnants of the former Separatist movement threatened to cause another outbreak of civil war, the trooper expressed utter hatred and contempt for the clones' [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] counterparts. He could not bear the thought of fighting against more of his enemies from the Clone Wars, all of whom he bitterly referred to as "gearheads."<ref name="BFII" />

His loyalty to the Empire was so complete to the point where he had no reservations for fighting against his own kind, specifically an entire generation of Fett clones that had been engineered to take up arms against the Empire. Yet despite his subservient nature, the trooper did not approve of the Emperor's decision to marginalize Jango Fett's progeny with additional clones based on different templates. As the years went by, the trooper lamented on how the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] steadily became more diverse, much to the chagrin of the Fett clones.<ref name="BFII" />

The trooper, like many of his fellow Clone Wars veterans, secretly enjoyed stamping out local insurrections, simply because they gave the stormtroopers something to do in a time when very few were willing to oppose the Empire's military might. When the Rebel Alliance declared war against the Empire, the trooper complimented how the Rebellion was organized and growing in number. After the Death Star's destruction, the trooper was filled with hatred for the Rebels, all of whom he blamed for the deaths of so many Imperial soldiers, including two thirds of the 501st, some of whom he had served with since the beginning of the Clone Wars. Thus he came to regard the Rebellion as a dangerous threat, not just to the Empire, but also to the peace and security of the galaxy.<ref name="BFII" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Armed with deadly new weapons, blazing new ships, and shiny new armor, our presence let the galaxy know that the days of the Old Republic were well and truly over.|Retired clone trooper|<ref name="BFII" />}}
The trooper was originally outfitted with the standard equipment of rank-and-file clone troopers, specifically the [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I battle armor]], the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]], and [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal]] [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. Near the end of the Clone Wars, his armor was replaced with its more advanced [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II successor]], which incorporated the distinctive [[blue]] markings of the 501st Legion.<ref name="BFII" />

When the Republic was reorganized into the Empire, the trooper upgraded to the standard [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|stormtrooper armor]]. His primary and secondary weapons were switched to the [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] and the [[SE-14r light repeating blaster/Legends|SE-14r light repeating blaster]], respectively.<ref name="BFII" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Temuera Morrison]] provided the voice of the battle-weary clone trooper, who is referred to in the ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' credits as the "retired clone trooper."<ref name="BFII" />
